cells.gaps: No source found counts ten or more institutions or systems connected to the Government Enterprise Service Bus; seven are named. No figure for exchanges through it. Irembo, a citizen services portal, is noted, not staged.
cells.note: Arrival 2026-11-15, raised from 2: in March 2025 the social registry shared data with other institutions through the Government Enterprise Service Bus, which the government reported in use, so a platform carries data between public bodies' systems. The seven systems named fall short of ten, and the Shared Government Data Hub is still being procured.
